def reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation):
    """
    Reverses the order of elements and punctuation marks together.
    Maintains the pairing relationship between elements and punctuation.

    Args:
        elements (list): List of element strings.
        punctuation (list): List of corresponding punctuation marks.

    Returns:
        tuple: Two lists - (reversed_elements, reversed_punctuation)
    """
    if len(elements) != len(punctuation):
        raise ValueError("elements and punctuation must have the same length")

    return (elements[::-1], punctuation[::-1])
